panels.description: Para estudiar frecuencia de flujo de datos

targets.rawSql:
-- SQL Script for Grafana Dashboard to Monitor Time Elapsed Between Data Packages Reception

SELECT
  DATE_SUB(a.timestamp, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS "time",
  TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, b.timestamp, a.timestamp) AS "time_elapsed_in_minutes"
FROM
  (SELECT *, @row_number_a:=@row_number_a + 1 AS rn FROM logs, (SELECT @row_number_a:=0) AS t WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND dev_id = '$h_id' ORDER BY timestamp) a
JOIN
  (SELECT *, @row_number_b:=@row_number_b + 1 AS rn FROM logs, (SELECT @row_number_b:=0) AS t WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND dev_id = '$h_id' ORDER BY timestamp) b
ON
  a.rn = b.rn + 1
ORDER BY
  a.timestamp;

-- SQL Script for Grafana Dashboard to Monitor Time Elapsed Between Data Packages Reception

SELECT
  DATE_SUB(a.timestamp, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS "time",
  TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, b.timestamp, a.timestamp) AS "time_elapsed_in_minutes"
FROM
  (SELECT *, @row_number_a:=@row_number_a + 1 AS rn FROM logs, (SELECT @row_number_a:=0) AS t WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND dev_id = '$h_id' ORDER BY timestamp) a
JOIN
  (SELECT *, @row_number_b:=@row_number_b + 1 AS rn FROM logs, (SELECT @row_number_b:=0) AS t WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND dev_id = '$h_id' ORDER BY timestamp) b
ON
  a.rn = b.rn + 1
ORDER BY
  a.timestamp;

SELECT

FROM logs
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND dev_id = '$h_id'
